grades.standsInFor: Stripe/Adyen/etc. (catalog ladder); the injectable transport hits a generic charges/refunds/webhooks API — swapping to a specific provider is one file (_wire.ts), never the port

consumers: checkout / payment action (domain code calls charge() with an idempotencyKey — never a raw provider client, never card material)
ledger read (balance()/ledger() power invoices and reporting off the SUM of entries, not a separately mutated total)
webhook boundary (inbound provider events pass through handleWebhook() — fail-closed — before anything trusts them)
